| Set | Records | Retrieved | Relative recall |
|---|---:|---:|---:|

These figures are relative recall against the known sets, not absolute sensitivity. The optional trajectory block reduced the count by 78.7%, but lost benchmark PMID 18629750, so it was left out. Its random loss sample contained 0 relevant records out of 30.

I assumed all ages, trauma types, languages, and study designs were eligible. The 32,074-record yield exceeds the standard-depth screening budget of 10,000; the internal critic accepted this as a documented risk. The draft needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
